data.name: AlexWitekCompany
data.value: Chairman of Alex Witek Company for General Import and Export, Chemical Trade, and Petroleum and Environmental Services

data.name: AlexWitekCompanyContent
data.value:
As part of the joint cooperation in the field of importing and exporting petroleum raw materials and products, as well as managing hazardous waste, Major General Dr. Engineer / Jamal Mahmoud, CEO of Emdad, received today, Tuesday, February 11, 2025, Mr. Chemist / Adel Abdel Aziz, Chairman of Alex Witek Company, with its branch in the Arab Republic of Egypt and its branch in the Sultanate of Oman.
Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies welcomed this fruitful and constructive cooperation in the areas that were agreed upon.

data.name: Djibouti
data.value: The Ambassador of Djibouti in Cairo receives the CEO of Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies.

data.name: DjiboutiContent
data.value:
Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies, with the presence of the CEO, Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors, Commercial Director, Director of External Relations, and Media Advisor, met today, Monday, January 13, 2025, with His Excellency Ambassador Ahmed Ali Biri, Ambassador of the Republic of Djibouti to the Arab Republic of Egypt, to discuss frameworks for joint cooperation and various investment opportunities.
Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies extends its sincere thanks for the warm reception and the fruitful results achieved.

data.name: Mauritania
data.value: The Ambassador of Mauritania in Cairo receives the CEO of Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies.

data.name: MauritaniaContent
data.value:
On Thursday, February 6, 2025, Mr. Al-Husseini Al-Deyeh, Ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania and Permanent Representative to the Arab League, met with Major General Dr. Engineer / Jamal Mahmoud, CEO of Emdad, to discuss frameworks for joint cooperation in the fields of military and civilian products, petroleum products, and agricultural investment.
The meeting was attended by the CEO, Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors, Commercial Director, Director of External Relations, and Media Advisor.
Emdad Company extends its sincere thanks for the warm reception and the fruitful and constructive results achieved, which support the ongoing meetings between the two parties.

data.name: Oman
data.value: The Omani Military Attaché in Cairo receives the delegation of Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies

data.name: OmanContent
data.value: Today, Monday, January 20, 2025, a delegation from Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies, with the presence of the Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors, the Commercial Director, and the Director of External Relations, met with the Omani Military Attaché Mr. Salah Ahmed Al-Marzouqi and Colonel / As'ad bin Said, Deputy Military Attaché, to discuss frameworks for joint cooperation in the marketing of civilian and military products. The company extends its sincere thanks to the Omani Military Attaché for the warm reception.

data.name: QualitySystemAccreditation
data.value: Celebration of the company's achievement in obtaining international accreditation for quality systems.

data.name: QualitySystemAccreditationContent
data.value: As part of Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies' commitment to keeping up with development according to international quality standards, the company was granted international accreditation certificates today, Wednesday, January 22, 2025, for the ISO 9001/2015 management system and the ISO 45001/2018 certification in occupational health and safety. This achievement was met with great joy from the company's employees, led by the CEO.

data.name: SierraLeone
data.value: The Ambassador of Sierra Leone in Cairo receives the CEO of Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies.

data.name: SierraLeoneContent
data.value: Today, Major General Dr. Engineer / Jamal Mahmoud of Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies, along with his accompanying delegation, met with His Excellency the Ambassador of Sierra Leone to discuss frameworks for joint cooperation and various investment opportunities. Emdad Heavy Industries and Mechanical Equipment Company and Commercial Agencies extends its sincere thanks for the warm reception and the fruitful results achieved.
